snippet.title: Pinfall | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875180/Pinfall/

From the center of the Earth to the outskirts of reality, overcome the impossible in Pinfall: An extremely difficult physics-based platformer where momentum is key. While talking to NPCs, collecting items, and customizing your look, keep climbing as the impending fall awaits...

Pinfall merges the rage game genre (Getting Over It, Pogostuck, Jump King) with pinball physics and mechanics, creating a brand new kind of rage game. Falls are extra punishing, and quick reflexes are essential to save yourself from falling farther. The ball is almost always moving, so be attentive!

Game by PIXELNASU: https://linktr.ee/pixelnasu
Trailer by Andrew Locke: https://www.youtube.com/@UC-PHmOL-CbirQ0keiM62BfA 
Promotional Art by Nellavu
